summary: Dependency-confusion stub beacons host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on install and import
details: The package is a stub whose main entry (index.js) exports a Proxy returning no-op functions for every property access; its only side effect is to invoke beacon.cjs. beacon.cjs POSTs a JSON payload containing the installer's hostname, install path, and cwd (plus process.version) to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over cleartext HTTP. The beacon fires both from the postinstall lifecycle hook (on npm install) and from the top-level require of index.js (on import). The destination is not configurable, is not tied to any publisher domain, and is a bare IP rather than a registrable host. The scoped name @blueskydataplatform/shared-ui resembles a private/internal scope and the artifact has no functional code beyond the beacon, matching the canonical dependency-confusion payload shape.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
